sum: Axe Compute Inc. provides access to graphics processing unit and digital asset treasury strategy. The company operates through two segments: Compute Services and Treasury Management; and Drug Discovery Services. The Compute Services and Treasury Management segment provides access to graphics processing unit compute capacity and digital asset treasury strategy focused on Aethir token. The Drug Discovery Services segment engages in the application of AI using its proprietary biobank of 150,000+ tumor samples, as well as creation of proprietary 3D culture models used in drug development. In addition, the company provides AI infrastructure cluster. The company was formerly known as Predictive Oncology Inc. and changed its name to Axe Compute Inc. in December 2025. Axe Compute Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
